hebrewText: וְ/לָ/מָ֤ה הֶֽעֱלִיתֻ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם לְ/הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔/נוּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הָ/רָ֖ע הַ/זֶּ֑ה לֹ֣א מְק֣וֹם זֶ֗רַע וּ/תְאֵנָ֤ה וְ/גֶ֨פֶן֙ וְ/רִמּ֔וֹן וּ/מַ֥יִם אַ֖יִן לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת

tokens.bdb: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
tokens.kjv: how (long, oft, (-soever)), (no-) thing, what (end, good, purpose, thing), whereby(-fore, -in, -to, -with), (for) why.

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.explanation: Mitsrayim — Egito. A terra das "duas margens" do Nilo

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
tokens.kjv: country, [idiom] home, [idiom] open, place, room, space, [idiom] whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: maqom — lugar, localidade, espaço físico, santuário

tokens.bdb: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
tokens.kjv: adversity, affliction, bad, calamity, [phrase] displease(-ure), distress, evil((-favouredness), man, thing), [phrase] exceedingly, [idiom] great, grief(-vous), harm, heavy, hurt(-ful), ill (favoured), [phrase] mark, mischief(-vous), misery, naught(-ty), noisome, [phrase] not please, sad(-ly), sore, sorrow, trouble, vex, wicked(-ly, -ness, one), worse(-st), wretchedness, wrong. (Incl. feminine raaah; as adjective or noun.).

tokens.bdb: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
tokens.kjv: he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which. Compare H2063 (זֹאת), H2090 (זֹה), H2097 (זוֹ), H2098 (זוּ).

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
tokens.kjv: country, [idiom] home, [idiom] open, place, room, space, [idiom] whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: maqom — lugar, localidade, espaço físico, santuário

tokens.bdb: seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity
a vine (as twining), especially the grape
a pomegranate, the tree (from its upright growth) or the fruit (also an artificial ornament)
water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.explanation: mayim — água, rio, mar (sempre plural em hebraico)

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.kjv: [idiom] assuredly, banquet, [idiom] certainly, drink(-er, -ing), drunk ([idiom] -ard), surely. (Prop. intensive of H8248 (שָׁקָה).)
